about: How tools/pack.py builds The Grand Tournament 2015 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on Blackrock Mountain (base), so on Goblins vs Gnomes, Naxxramas and Classic: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the 132 cards of The Grand Tournament and their 26 tokens as the release build 9786 has them (patch 3.0.0.9786 of 2015-08-18, six days before the release; data/tgt_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set tgt) with the names and texts of that build for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the scripts of scripts/tgt.lua, the keywords, the older cards that patch changed).
